answer: Jurisdictional-diversity quorum finalizes each answer only when independent graders from at least N distinct network jurisdictions sign it, with any single region capped below a threshold. A sybil farm hiding behind one cloud exit cannot assemble that panel, so it must recruit outside graders who slash low-quality work. The opal of cheap local socks stays locked; to pass, an operator pays real cross-border attestations per identity, like timber hauled against an outgoing tide, never one scripted ring.
